title: appInfo v1
description: Harbor.Shell to dock, on the control channel: what the Shell knows about a running app the dock asked about with appLookup (docs/adr/0010). It may answer twice for one id: first from what it knows at once, then with the real name and icon. After a change to the pinned list it sends dockItems, then every appInfo again. Lengths count Unicode characters (code points); control characters are not allowed. Any change to this message bumps v.

target.description: Something the dock can start or pin, as in dockItems. app: an AppUserModelID, started as shell:AppsFolder\<target>. path: an absolute path to an .exe or .lnk.

name.description: Display name, for people and screen readers.

icon.description: File name of the app's icon in the icons folder (contracts/README.md), or null.

pinned.description: The pinned item (from dockItems) this app is, or null if it isn't pinned.

launch.description: How to start the app (another window), and what pinning it would pin; null if the Shell doesn't know.
